args.title: Bellwether Office newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest newsletter covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" and links to a blog article plus a companion piece that can be tailored by reader/company.
• Linked article (blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion): Pilots of the approach cut claims by a quarter.
